newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS H1 rises sharply, beats forecasts.
newsitem.headline: PGS H1 rises sharply, beats forecasts.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) reported on Wednesday a 53 percent surge in pre-tax profits in the first half from a year ago to $38.59 million.
Operating profits for the six months jumped to $50.327 million against $32.965 million in the 1996 period.
The Houston-headquartered company attributed the rise to improved efficiency, good market conditions and strong sales in the key three-dimension seismic sector.
The results beat expectations and shares in PGS on the Oslo bourse had risen 9.5 percent by 1455 GMT to a high of 405 crowns.
